scenes: How can a brick kiln melt a glacier?
Through black carbon: soot. | It warms the air as it drifts. | Then it settles on snow and ice, | darkening them, so they soak up sunlight and melt faster.
In the Hindu Kush Himalaya, glaciers lost ice sixty-five per cent faster in the 2010s.
Cleaner stoves, engines and kilns cut it, | and clean the air people breathe.
Less soot, slower melt, cleaner air.
